name: Individual Placement and Support for Change Grow Live service users
whoFor: Change Grow Live service users in Kirklees aged 18 and over who want to move into paid work.
eligibility: Aged 18 or over and in treatment at Change Grow Live
Out of work, or in work but at risk of losing their job because of substance use and/or ill health
Consents to receive input from the IPS service and has a GP registered within Kirklees
exclusions: Only wants to look at voluntary work or education
gate: Is in treatment with Change Grow Live

activities.name: Individual Placement and Support
activities.summary: A 'place then train' approach matching people in recovery with paid work they want to do. An Employment Specialist builds a vocational profile, engages employers, supports CVs and interviews and agrees reasonable adjustments, then supports the person and their employer once in work.
activities.duration: Job coaching/placement up to 9 months; follow-along support for the first 4 months in work

provenance.source: Kirklees HWL Pathways Aug 26 v2.1 (draft 15 Sept 2026; grant-funded schemes added 12 Oct 2026)
